title: Neon Do’s
slide_intent: Make an effect behave like part of a scene so viewers can understand it as a connection rather than decoration.
strategic_value: Purposeful, perspective-aware neon can give T-Mobile’s network metaphor a consistent visual behavior.
demonstration: Four still examples show neighborhood wash, a city changing from monochrome to color, device outlines and a road trace.
practical_value: Check perspective, environmental interaction and what the light is connecting before using the effect.

content_islands.name: Behavior rules
content_islands.spec: Place motion speed, dimensionality, perspective and selective-coverage guidance at left.

content_islands.name: Environmental examples
content_islands.spec: Pair neighborhood wash and city transformation across the upper row.

content_islands.name: Device and road examples
content_islands.spec: Place device outlining and a road trace in the lower row with their specific captions.

ingredient.name: Network neon behavior
ingredient.role: Trace a connection through an environment in a legible way.
ingredient.application: Move swiftly with purpose; vary line thickness with depth and let glow interact with surfaces. Connect most, not all, places.
ingredient.scope: Road outlines are excluded when representing T-Mobile Home Internet. Motion is described by the source, not demonstrated by the static PNG.
